title: Overlapped groupings for quantum energy estimation: Maximal variance reduction and deterministic algorithms for reducing variance
summary: Grouping-based measurement strategies are widely used to reduce measurement complexity in near-term quantum algorithms. While these schemes have typically produced disjoint groups, recently this has been relaxed in what is known as overlapped grouping or coefficient splitting where operators may appear in more than one compatible group. In recent work, it has been numerically shown that this strategy can reduce the variance of energy estimates on small benchmark problems, motivating both the application and further analysis of the method.
